title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding $70,739 in extreme fear—but the real story's geopolitical, not technical.

Petrodollar mechanics are breaking down in real time around the Strait of Hormuz. Every barrel that can't clear in dollars is a proof-of-work moment for sovereign-free currency. Nobody's pricing this yet.

On-chain picture's cleaner than the macro chaos suggests. Mempool's lean at 20,910 txs, fastest fees at 2 sat/vB—network's not stressed, which means smart money's patient.
